prompt: A single wide illustration shows a fortified customs gate stamped with national-security seals, through which scarce high-end training chips in locked crates are halted by officers demanding licences while identical-looking mass-market inference boards stream unhindered into robots, cameras and vehicles; behind the gate, grey arrows trace the same chips being relabelled, routed through third-country warehouses and stripped from discarded electronics until they reappear inside a captured missile whose civilian modules are being photographed and catalogued by intelligence analysts, while two officials in the foreground argue across a glowing schematic that draws a contested legal line between “training chips” and “inference chips.”
